testsuite.name: com.chromascape.web.debug.tickdebugger.websocket.TickStreamWebSocketHandlerTest

testcase.name: a successful transport-error finalization prevents close retry
the PERSISTED acknowledgment carries the exact tick-batch-ack/v1 schema
handler passes the precision-safe original JsonNode to ingestion
an unbound tick sends SESSION_NOT_BOUND and invokes nothing
a late tick after stop cannot recreate shadow state
a mismatched stop sends SESSION_ID_MISMATCH
a failed response send invokes synchronous compensation and clears ownership
a data-integrity failure from the service sends no acknowledgment
a mismatched tick sends SESSION_ID_MISMATCH
an explicit failure followed by transport and close performs only the close fallback
a repeated stop does not run finalization twice
a repeated stop sends SESSION_STOPPING without finalizing again
a stop without a binding is rejected
a tick on a stopping connection sends SESSION_STOPPING
a late tick after an explicit stop cannot recreate a closed run
no decision message is broadcast when no decision is produced
two WebSockets cannot stop one another's sessions
a rejected unbound tick does not invoke ingestion
a successful persistence result sends a PERSISTED batch acknowledgment
two WebSockets on one handler cannot bind the same preferred session
a packet validation failure maps to BATCH_PACKET_INVALID, never a retry
a mismatched tick does not invoke inference or ingestion
a matching bound tick invokes evaluation/publication and ingestion
a tick without SESSION_START is rejected without invoking anything
a stop for a different session is rejected
persistence failure sends an error and never sends a batch acknowledgment
ordinary ingestion still runs when an accepted shadow publication throws
a tick arriving during STOPPING is rejected
a failed transport-error finalization receives exactly one close retry
a failed explicit stop receives exactly one disconnect retry
a valid stop changes the binding to EXPLICIT_STOP_FAILED before finalization
a successful explicit stop prevents disconnect finalization
every permanent rejection maps to its stable protocol code
ordinary ingestion still runs when an accepted shadow evaluation throws
an unbound stop sends SESSION_NOT_BOUND
a successful explicit stop releases both ownership maps
repeated transport errors do not repeat finalization
a failed close finalization is not attempted a third time
a second SESSION_START on one connection is rejected without replacing the binding
